title: Gradual latency climb on orders-api then 5xx
symptoms: occasional allocation failures or container restarts late in the incident
request duration stretching over the afternoon
callers seeing timeouts and 5xx once the process was under heap pressure
observed_signals: latency correlated with memory; errors arrived later
GC pause time and heap-used warnings increased with memory
CPU increased only moderately until GC became frequent

timeline.event: a library bump shipped on orders-api
memory_usage on orders-api began a near-linear climb
p95 latency on orders-api moved with memory
error-rate or latency alert fired on orders-api
a second climb started until the code fix landed

contributing_factors: a library upgrade retained objects that should have been released
GC hid the problem until pauses became visible
resolution: rolled back the library version that retained extra objects
captured a heap dump before the second restart
added a slow memory-growth monitor (15-minute slope)
lessons_learned: heap dumps need to be taken before the second crash
page on sustained memory slope, not only on OOM
